paper.title: Regularized Distribution Matching Distillation for One-step Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation
paper.venue_note: Accepted to the Structured Probabilistic Inference and Generative Modeling workshop of ICML 2024

compute_policy: local CPU/local GTX 1050 only; no HF cpu-upgrade, Jobs, paid, or remote compute
cpu_feasibility: Claim 1 is a theoretical-optimum statement and cannot be established or falsified by finite CPU optimization; Claim 4's paper-faithful neural training path is not implemented here.

claim_1_outcome.scope: Pinned-primary-source theorem/CPU feasibility audit; finite CPU optimization cannot establish or falsify the universal theoretical-optimum convergence claim.

claim_4_outcome.scope: Reduced deterministic assignment surrogate preserving 2-D Gaussian/8-Gaussian inputs, squared transport cost, radial target-fidelity proxy, and strict segment intersections; not trained RDMD or a Section 5.1 reproduction.
